Translate body mass index (BMI) into body weight classes

Source: R/physiological_calculations.R
obesity_class.Rd

Based on NIH / NHLBI Expert Panel (1998) — Clinical Guidelines on the Identification, Evaluation, and Treatment of Overweight and Obesity in Adults, Table ES-2 (NCBI Bookshelf).

Usage

obesity_class(bmi)

Arguments

bmi

A numerical vector.

Value

A character vector.

Details

https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/files/docs/guidelines/prctgd_c.pdf
